about.en: META is the native token of MetaDAO, a Solana-based fundraising and governance platform built on futarchy, where proposals are decided by conditional markets on the token's price rather than by token voting. The token is an SPL token minted at METAwkXcqyXKy1AtsSgJ8JiUHwGCafnZL38n3vYmeta and is unrelated to the shares of Meta Platforms, which use the same ticker on equity markets.
